purpose: Original unofficial study-bank expansion from 30 to 150 questions; documentation retrieval is grounding, not question generation or automatic verification.

objectiveConfirmation.summary: Fresh Learn MCP evidence confirms the same current three-domain, nine-skill, 54-subskill outline and published weights. The canonical snapshot and existing objective-bound reviews were not renewed merely because the same guide was retrieved again.

reviewWorkflow.groundedGeneration: Six bounded author contexts generated 120 candidates. Six distinct reviewer contexts independently inspected their actual cited evidence, every option and question-specific realism criteria.
reviewWorkflow.repairs: Independent review withheld sc200-037 and sc200-054 for unrealistic distractors, sc200-060 for unsupported retroactive WEF replay, and sc200-120 for overbroad custom sensitive-type naming claims. A separate author repaired those exact records and a fresh independent reviewer reassessed them. The original withheld versions and their actual reviews remain under authoring-history/expansion-20260916-before-repair.
reviewWorkflow.policyHolds: sc200-043, sc200-044, sc200-060, sc200-061 and sc200-120 remained manual-review-required while official source URL shapes were unsupported. After the shared source-policy fix, another independent context read the actual evidence and every option before issuing exact-content releases. Earlier holds remain under authoring-history/expansion-20260916-before-policy-release.
reviewWorkflow.rubric: Each final record has an independently authored ten-criterion 0-2 rubric, at least 18/20, no zero, and 2 for accuracy, answer uniqueness and documentation strength. Hashes bind exact content and objective snapshots; structural success does not prove semantic correctness.
reviewWorkflow.editorialReview: All individual warnings were assessed in the independent review notes. The final combined 150-question duplicate check found no blockers or duplicate warnings. Remaining negative, absolute and pronoun heuristics are retained in the generated report, not waived by suppressing checks.

redirectConfirmations.method: The bounded online checker observed these official redirects. Each exact destination was then fetched through Microsoft Learn MCP and its full returned document text matched the previously independently reviewed receipt byte-for-byte. Only the exact destination was added to SC-200's allowlist; existing source URLs, snapshots, review dates, question fingerprints and attestations were preserved. These are availability/identity confirmations, not fabricated source-review renewals.

identity.summary: The current credential page exposes a 12-month renewal program and links this official overview, which explicitly offers renewal to existing holders expiring within six months. This supports an established active credential without inventing a GA metadata field or relying on scheduling alone. No assessment questions were accessed; renewal skills were not used as the current exam objective map.
